ops.body: - [loop] (low) A failed write of Contents' switch (Bring moments back) leaves the open sheet showing a setting that was not kept: `resurface/shell.ts` `setPrefs` sets the store before the write and never puts it back when the write fails, and since `tend memories T54` the sheet stays up to show it. Fix: on a failed write, the store back to the setting kept and the sheet's switch with it, with a shell test over `fakePorts()` first (the batch's review, auditor F11, Nov 24)

argv: A failed write of Contents' switch
ops.body: - [loop] (low) At 320 px, with Contents open over Memories, a stray clipped "2025" shows under the day's heading behind the sheet (`resurface-t54-contents-switch-off-320.png`, the batch's end pass); its cause is not found, and it may be older than `tend memories T54` (the batch's review, ux U8, Nov 24)

argv: the owner's yes, built in tend memories T54
